title: Fast Computing Formulas for some Dirichlet L-Series
summary: For $χ_k$ a self$-$dual primitive Dirichlet character mod $k$ several reduced identities of Dirichlet $L-$functions $L_k(s):=L(s,χ_k)$, expressed as linear combinations of Hurwitz $ζ$ functions, are found for $s=2,3$ and some selected values of $k$. By using a merged approach between the Wilf$-$Zeilberger method and a Dougall$'$s $_5H_5$ technique, new proven accelerated series of hypergeometric$-$type are derived for specific Hurwitz $ζ$ function values.
